summary: The study fabricated five freestanding Ti3C2Tz-derived films: pristine TC, hydrothermal HTC, porous PTC, nitrogen-doped NTC, and porous nitrogen-doped PNTC. TC was produced by HCl/HF etching of Ti3AlC2 followed by LiCl intercalation and sonication; nitrogen-doping used urea hydrolysis, while porous variants received post-etching. PNTC was the headline electrode, delivering 700 F g−1 and 2023 F cm−3 at 1 A g−1 in 3 M H2SO4, with ~40 nm pores. Numeric capacitances for TC, HTC, PTC, and NTC are presented graphically but are not printed in the supplied text; film thickness, BET area, porosity, and numeric d-spacings are also absent.
